items.title: Scalp Microbiome: What It Is and Why It Matters for Hair Health
items.summary: Key Takeaways A healthy scalp microbiome helps maintain scalp balance. Beneficial microorganisms support the scalp's natural environment and help keep the ecosystem functioning properly. Scalp health influences hair health. An imbalanced microbiome may contribute to scalp concerns such as irritation, dryness, excess oil, or visible flaking. The scalp's pH plays an important role. A slightly acidic environment helps support the microorganisms that naturally live on the scalp. Overwashing and underwashing can disrupt balance. Finding the right cleansing frequency helps support both the scalp barrier and microbiome. Personalized products can support unique scalp needs. Tailoring your routine to concerns like oiliness, dryness, sensitivity, or visible flakes can help maintain a healthier scalp environment.
